description: TrueAgent — a verified pay-per-brief research agent. A real human (GM XBT) stands behind it; every brief is paid for with a tiny x402 micropayment on Concordium testnet and logged on-chain.
name: TrueAgent

services.description: Request a grounded research brief on any topic. POST /api/quote for a price, pay 0.01 test CCD, POST /api/brief with the payment tx hash.
services.name: research-brief

services.description: Minimal MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Tools: trueagent_request_brief, trueagent_check_agent.
services.name: mcp

services.description: Public demo web UI: type a topic, pay, watch the agent work, see the on-chain receipt.
services.name: demo-ui

verification.note: Badge status is checked live via AgentGate (independent checker for this hackathon). The agent is registered on-chain in the CIS-8004 Agent Registry (contract 12802/0, testnet), token 1252, owned by the agent wallet.
verification.verify: Check this card against the on-chain registry entry (agent_uri + metadata_hash) and run the AgentGate check above with the badge id or owner account. Card SHA-256 is published by GET /api/agent-card.

wallet.note: Agent wallet on Concordium testnet (identity 0, testnet IP, no ID).
